pax_rpg_gate_hint: E — back to the world map
pax_rpg_controls: WASD — walk · Shift — run · Space — jump · F — draw / sheathe the sword · LMB — strike (three in a row — combo) · Alt — dodge · RMB + mouse — turn the camera
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_1: The road winds through blue forests. Ahead lies {city}.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_2: Pink mana clouds sink lower. You enter {city}.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_3: The guards at the gate watch you pass. {city} does not like strangers.
pax_rpg_narrator_enter_4: Mana mist trembles over the roofs. {city} greets you with the noise of its streets.
pax_rpg_narrator_leave_1: You leave the city. The world of Yuruma lies before you again.
pax_rpg_narrator_leave_2: The gate closes behind you. Where now?
